  1. 01 / Before the timeline

    Tell us what you're making.

    Share your footage, a reference and your deadline. We agree on scope, price and timing before the edit starts.

  2. 02 / In the edit

    See the first cut.

    We build the structure and feel. You get a first version to watch and a clear place to start the conversation.

  3. 03 / The last details

    Make it feel right.

    We work through the agreed feedback and prepare the final files for the formats you need.
